Summary\\n\\nOn Strix Halo (gfx1151), any PyTorch GPU operation leaves the ROCR runtime's `AsyncEventsLoop` thread busy-spinning at 100% of one CPU core, permanently, for the remaining life of the process. This occurs **only with the pip-bundled runtime** shipped inside the TheRock-built wheels (`_rocm_sdk_core`, ROCR 1.21.0 line) \u2014 both the nightly channel and the new production multi-arch channel. The classic packaged release runtime (ROCR 1.18.0, `rocm-rel-7.2`) is completely quiet on the **same machine and same kernel**, which is why I believe this is a runtime regression in the 1.21 line rather than a platform/kernel issue.\\n\\nFor long-running inference servers (our use case: resident TTS services) this silently costs one full core per process \u2014 two of ours had accumulated ~15 CPU-hours each before we noticed.\\n\\n### Environment\\n\\n- HW: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo), Radeon 8060S iGPU, gfx1151\\n- OS: Fedora 44, kernel `7.1.5-201.fc44.x86_64`\\n- Python 3.12\\n\\n### Affected / unaffected matrix (all on the same box, same kernel, same repro)\\n\\n| Stack | rocr in `/proc/PID/maps` | ROCR BUILD ID | Idle CPU after one GPU op |\\n|---|---|---|---|\\n| `rocm==7.13.0a20260411` nightly + `torch 2.12.0a0+rocm7.13.0a20260411` | venv `_rocm_sdk_core` | `1.21.0-local-build-c76140fa27` | **~100% of a core, indefinitely** |\\n| `rocm==7.14.0` from `repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-multi-arch/` + `torch 2.12.0+rocm7.14.0` (`[device-gfx1151]`) | venv `_rocm_sdk_core` | `1.21.0-local-build-2b22ab01` | **~100% of a core, indefinitely** |\\n| System ROCm 7.2.0 (dnf, EL10 repo) + `torch 2.9.1+rocm7.2.1.lw` from `repo.radeon.com` | `/opt/rocm-7.2.0/lib` | `1.18.0-rocm-rel-7.2-43-fc0010cf6a` | **0% \u2014 fully idle** |\\n\\n### Minimal repro\\n\\n```bash\\npython -m venv v && v/bin/pip install --index-url https://repo.amd.com/rocm/whl-multi-arch/ \\\\\\n  \\\"torch[device-gfx1151]==2.12.0+rocm7.14.0\\\"\\nv/bin/python -c '\\nimport torch, time\\nx = torch.rand(2048, 2048, device=\\\"cuda\\\")\\n(x @ x).sum(); torch.cuda.synchronize()\\nprint(\\\"work done \u2014 watch this process now\\\")\\ntime.sleep(300)'\\n```\\n\\nAfter \\\"work done\\\", the process burns a full core for the whole sleep (`~999 ticks per 10s` from `/proc/PID/stat` utime; our resident services confirm it never stops). Before the first GPU op the process idles normally \u2014 the spin arms on first kernel launch.\\n\\n### Where it spins\\n\\n`eu-stack` on the hot thread (pure user time; **zero syscalls** during a 3s `strace -c` attach, i.e. memory polling, not epoll):\\n\\n```\\n#0  rocr::core::Runtime::AsyncEventsLoop(void*)\\n#3  rocr::core::Signal::WaitAnyExceptions(unsigned int, hsa_signal_s const*, hsa_signal_condition_t const*, long const*, long*)\\n#4  rocr::core::Runtime::AsyncEventsLoop(void*)\\n#1  rocr::os::ThreadTrampoline(void*)\\n```\\n\\nA sibling thread is properly blocked in `hsaKmtWaitOnMultipleEvents` (ioctl), so kernel event delivery works on this system \u2014 it is specifically the `AsyncEventsLoop` signal set that polls. The ROCm 6.3.2 release notes describe a fix (\\\"the runtime won't spin on the CPU if all events are busy\\\"); the behavior here looks like that path regressed or is not engaged in the 1.21 line on gfx1151.\\n\\n### Ruled out\\n\\n- `HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION`: identical spin with and without (paired runs).\\n- `HSA_ENABLE_INTERRUPT=1`: no effect.\\n- Our application stack: the repro above is bare torch; no server, no sockets.\\n- Kernel-only explanation: same kernel runs the 1.18 release runtime with zero idle CPU.\\n\\nCaveat stated plainly: this box runs Fedora's kernel (not the validated Ubuntu matrix). Both arms of the discriminator shared it, so the runtime build is the variable \u2014 but I have not yet reproduced on a validated distro.\\n\\nHappy to run further diagnostics (env flags, debug builds, `ROCR_*` knobs) on this hardware \u2014 it can reproduce on demand.\\n\",\"closed_by\":null,\"reactions\":{\"url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ROCm/TheRock/issues/7051/reactions\",\"total_count\":1,\"+1\":0,\"-1\":0,\"laugh\":0,\"hooray\":0,\"confused\":0,\"heart\":0,\"rocket\":0,\"eyes\":1},\"timeline_url\":\"https://api.github.com/repos/ROCm/TheRock/issues/7051/timeline\",\"performed_via_github_app\":null,\"state_reason\":null,\"pinned_comment\":null}"}

Body\\n\\n### Summary\\n\\nAfter a `TextGenerate` (LLM autoregressive text generation) workload triggers an `amdgpu: ... queue evicted` kernel message, ROCm's HSA runtime `AsyncEventsLoop` thread starts spinning at 100% CPU indefinitely (`wchan=0`, never re-entering a kernel wait state) instead of returning to sleep. Unlike the GPU-hang reports elsewhere (#5151, #5590, #6012), `rocm-smi` confirms **the GPU itself is idle (`GPU use (%): 0`)** the whole time \u2014 no MES `REMOVE_QUEUE` failure, no page faults, no GPU reset attempted or needed. It looks like a livelock purely inside the userspace HSA runtime's async-event handling, not a GPU/MES hang.\\n\\nThis is a single-process repro (not the 4+ concurrent-process scenario in #6012), and occurs on a ROCm/PyTorch build (`7.14.0a20260529`) that postdates the CWSR fix described in #5590 by about three months.\\n\\n### Environment\\n- Hardware: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo, gfx1151), unified memory\\n- Host OS: Fedora 42, kernel `6.18.12-100.fc42.x86_64`\\n- MES firmware: `0x80` (`MES feature version: 1, firmware version: 0x00000080`)\\n- ROCm/PyTorch: TheRock nightly `torch 2.13.0a0+rocm7.14.0a20260529`, `rocm-sdk-core` / `rocm-sdk-libraries-gfx1151` `7.14.0a20260529` (built 2026-05-29)\\n- Workload: [ComfyUI](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI) running in a rootless podman/toolbox container (`--pid=host`), using the built-in `TextGenerate` node (Qwen3VL/Llama text-encoder backend) for autoregressive text generation \u2014 i.e. repeated decode-step compute queue activity, single process\\n- `amdgpu.cwsr_enable`: not set (default) at time of repro\\n\\n### Steps to reproduce\\n1. On gfx1151, run a sustained autoregressive LLM decode workload (in our case: ComfyUI's `TextGenerate` node, `max_length=512`, sampling mode \\\"on\\\" \u2014 temperature/top_k/top_p/min_p \u2014 using `torch.multinomial` per decode step).\\n2. This variant first hit a hard crash: `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION`, code `0x1016`, surfaced at `at::native::item()` (the async-error sync point), after 1/512 tokens generated:\\n ```\\n Queue error: HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION: An HSAIL operation resulted in a hardware exception.\\n :0:rocdevice.cpp:4096: Callback: Queue 0x... aborting with error : HSA_STATUS_ERROR_EXCEPTION ... code: 0x1016\\n terminate called after throwing an instance of 'c10::AcceleratorError'\\n what(): CUDA error: unspecified launch failure\\n ```\\n3. Switching the node to greedy decoding (`do_sample=False`, no multinomial/top-k/top-p) avoided that crash. However, on a subsequent run, the process stopped crashing but got stuck consuming a full CPU core indefinitely with no forward progress in the ComfyUI queue.\\n\\n### Investigation of the stuck process\\n\\nAll of the following was captured live, ~2.5 hours after the process got stuck, with the spinning thread still spinning and the GPU still idle.\\n\\nPer-thread CPU/wait-channel scan of the main process (`/proc//task/*/{stat,wchan}`) \u2014 one thread (`273248`) stands out with `wchan=0` (never enters a kernel wait state) and CPU time climbing continuously, while every other thread is parked on `futex_do_wait` or `hrtimer_nanosleep`:\\n\\n
\\nthread CPU/wchan scan (top entries)\\n\\n```\\n273248 python utime=875651 stime=56 wchan=0\\n273325 python utime=29162 stime=647 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n290319 python utime=832 stime=45 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n290324 python utime=829 stime=48 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n290329 python utime=828 stime=44 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n290320 python utime=823 stime=42 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n290305 python utime=823 stime=43 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n290321 python utime=822 stime=46 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n273302 python utime=821 stime=306 wchan=hrtimer_nanosleep\\n290312 python utime=819 stime=44 wchan=futex_do_wait\\n```\\n
\\n\\n`py-spy dump --pid
` \u2014 every Python-level thread (main asyncio loop, `AMDGPUMonitor` monitor thread, `prompt_worker`) is idle/blocked as expected. Thread `273248` does not appear here at all, confirming it's a native thread spawned outside Python's `threading` module:\\n\\n
\\npy-spy dump\\n\\n```\\nProcess 273161: python main.py --port 8000 --output-directory ... --gpu-only --disable-smart-memory --cache-none --bf16-vae --listen 0.0.0.0\\nPython v3.13.13 (/usr/bin/python3.13)\\n\\nThread 273161 (idle): \\\"MainThread\\\"\\n select (selectors.py:452)\\n _run_once (asyncio/base_events.py:2023)\\n run_forever (asyncio/base_events.py:683)\\n run_until_complete (asyncio/base_events.py:712)\\n (main.py:575)\\nThread 273302 (idle): \\\"Thread-2 (monitor_thread_function)\\\"\\n select (selectors.py:398)\\n _communicate (subprocess.py:2154)\\n communicate (subprocess.py:1222)\\n run (subprocess.py:556)\\n run_rocm_smi_command (ComfyUI-AMDGPUMonitor/__init__.py:72)\\n get_gpu_info (ComfyUI-AMDGPUMonitor/__init__.py:92)\\n monitor_thread_function (ComfyUI-AMDGPUMonitor/__init__.py:215)\\n run (threading.py:995)\\n _bootstrap_inner (threading.py:1044)\\n _bootstrap (threading.py:1015)\\nThread 273325 (idle): \\\"Thread-3 (prompt_worker)\\\"\\n wait (threading.py:363)\\n get (execution.py:1264)\\n prompt_worker (main.py:346)\\n run (threading.py:995)\\n _bootstrap_inner (threading.py:1044)\\n _bootstrap (threading.py:1015)\\nThread 290368 (idle): \\\"Thread-5\\\"\\n wait (threading.py:363)\\n wait (threading.py:660)\\n run (tqdm/_monitor.py:60)\\n _bootstrap_inner (threading.py:1044)\\n _bootstrap (threading.py:1015)\\nThread 291319 (idle): \\\"asyncio_0\\\"\\n _worker (concurrent/futures/thread.py:90)\\n run (threading.py:995)\\n _bootstrap_inner (threading.py:1044)\\n _bootstrap (threading.py:1015)\\n```\\n
\\n\\n`gdb -p 273248 -batch -ex bt -ex 'info registers rip' -ex 'thread apply all bt'`, run inside the container's own mount namespace so symbols resolve correctly:\\n\\n
\\ngdb backtrace of the spinning thread\\n\\n```\\n0x00007f9c805d395e in rocr::core::Runtime::AsyncEventsLoop(void*) () from /opt/venv/lib64/python3.13/site-packages/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/libhsa-runtime64.so.1\\n#0 0x00007f9c805d395e in rocr::core::Runtime::AsyncEventsLoop(void*) ()\\n from /opt/venv/lib64/python3.13/site-packages/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/libhsa-runtime64.so.1\\n#1 0x00007f9c8063cc3a in rocr::os::ThreadTrampoline(void*) ()\\n from /opt/venv/lib64/python3.13/site-packages/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/libhsa-runtime64.so.1\\n#2 0x00007f9c93cbda39 in start_thread () from /lib64/libc.so.6\\n#3 0x00007f9c93d418dc in __clone3 () from /lib64/libc.so.6\\nrip 0x7f9c805d395e 0x7f9c805d395e \\n\\nThread 1 (Thread 0x7f9a969ff6c0 (LWP 273248) \\\"python\\\"):\\n#0 0x00007f9c805d395e in rocr::core::Runtime::AsyncEventsLoop(void*) ()\\n from /opt/venv/lib64/python3.13/site-packages/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/libhsa-runtime64.so.1\\n#1 0x00007f9c8063cc3a in rocr::os::ThreadTrampoline(void*) ()\\n from /opt/venv/lib64/python3.13/site-packages/_rocm_sdk_core/lib/libhsa-runtime64.so.1\\n#2 0x00007f9c93cbda39 in start_thread () from /lib64/libc.so.6\\n#3 0x00007f9c93d418dc in __clone3 () from /lib64/libc.so.6\\n[Inferior 1 (process 273248) detached]\\n```\\n
\\n\\n`journalctl -k --since today | grep -iE \\\"amdgpu|kfd\\\"` \u2014 only one eviction event around when this run started, not a cascade, and no `MES failed to respond`, page faults, or `GPU reset begin!` anywhere in the day's log (three earlier unrelated eviction events from other runs, all also without any hang/reset follow-up):\\n\\n
\\ndmesg / journalctl amdgpu+kfd, today\\n\\n```\\nJul 26 00:11:53 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7f01d5400000, queue evicted\\nJul 26 00:11:53 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7f01d6c00000, queue evicted\\nJul 26 00:24:30 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7fc9c2400000, queue evicted\\nJul 26 00:24:30 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7fc9c3c00000, queue evicted\\nJul 26 11:22:30 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7fe618e00000, queue evicted\\nJul 26 11:23:03 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7f78e3600000, queue evicted\\nJul 26 11:23:03 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7f78e4e00000, queue evicted\\nJul 26 13:09:39 z2 kernel: amdgpu: Freeing queue vital buffer 0x7f6806800000, queue evicted\\n```\\n
\\n\\n`rocm-smi --showuse --showpids`, captured live while thread `273248` was actively spinning \u2014 GPU confirmed idle, process still resident in KFD:\\n\\n
\\nrocm-smi snapshot\\n\\n```\\n============================ ROCm System Management Interface ============================\\n=================================== % time GPU is busy ===================================\\nGPU[0]\\t\\t: GPU use (%): 0\\n==========================================================================================\\n===================================== KFD Processes ======================================\\nKFD process information:\\nPID \\tPROCESS NAME\\tGPU(s)\\tVRAM USED\\tSDMA USED\\tCU OCCUPANCY\\t\\n273161\\tUNKNOWN \\t1 \\t532365312\\t0 \\tUNKNOWN \\t\\n==========================================================================================\\n================================== End of ROCm SMI Log ===================================\\n```\\n
\\n\\n### Expected behavior\\n`AsyncEventsLoop` should return to blocking/waiting after handling the queue-eviction event, as it presumably does in the non-buggy path, rather than busy-spinning forever.\\n\\n### Additional notes\\nThis occurred with `amdgpu.cwsr_enable` at its default (not disabled).   ## Overview                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   llama.cpp 0.3.0 introduces the dots3-note multimodal model (with a new DSA-ISWA KV cache), MTP support for GLM-4.5-Air, and tensor-split (`-sm tensor`) plus multi-sequence rollback fixes for DeepSeek 4. ggml is bumped to v0.22.0 (meta-backend tensor split, per-op Metal kernels with parallel compilation, non-in-place `ggml_clamp`), while mtmd gains dots3-note vision/audio, WebP decoding and a Pillow-accurate resize. The server adds a `LLAMA_SERVER_SLOTS_N_DIFF` debug knob, and the web UI gets tabbed chat navigation.                                        \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   ### New models                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   - Add dots3-note model with a new DSA-ISWA KV cache type ([#27060](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27060))                                                                                                                                                                   \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   ### Core changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   - DeepSeek 4: add tensor-split mode via `-sm tensor` ([#26490](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26490))                                                                                                                                                                       \\r\\n   - DeepSeek 4: fix rollback with multiple sequences ([#26756](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26756))                                                                                                                                                                         \\r\\n   - Fix meta tensor split state propagation for tensor parallel ([#27574](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27574))                                                                                                                                                              \\r\\n   - GLM-4.5-Air: add MTP (multi-token prediction) support ([#26534](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26534))                                                                                                                                                                    \\r\\n   - bailingmoe3: support DSpark ([#27508](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27508))                                                                                                                                                                                              \\r\\n   - mamba2: flatten in/out projections to dispatch GEMM instead of GEMV ([#27513](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27513))                                                                                                                                                      \\r\\n   - Models: use `ggml_rope_set_offset` in deepseek2/4, dflash, minicpm3 and plm ([#27382](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27382))                                                                                                                                              \\r\\n   - Grammar: parse `\\\\-` in char classes as a literal hyphen ([#27591](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27591))                                                                                                                                                                  \\r\\n   - Common: add `json.h` abstraction ([#27511](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27511)) with a clang LTO fix ([#27575](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27575))                                                                                                       \\r\\n   - Common: `fit` moved out of the server and now takes `n_streams` into account ([#27496](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27496))                                                                                                                                             \\r\\n   - Common: fix draft-mtp with embeddings ([#27400](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27400))                                                                                                                                                                                    \\r\\n   - Arg: remove the `-no-cnv` CLI option ([#27542](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27542))                                                                                                                                                                                     \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   ### Multi-modality changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   - Support dots3-note vision and audio ([#27524](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27524))                                                                                                                                                                                      \\r\\n   - Support WebP images via ffmpeg ([#27520](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27520))                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   - Fix loading videos with the moov atom at the end of the file ([#27596](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27596))                                                                                                                                                             \\r\\n   - Use a Pillow-accurate resize algorithm and correct `resize_algo` for all models ([#27594](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27594))                                                                                                                                          \\r\\n   - Use `ggml_rope_set_offset` in the CLIP graph ([#27521](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27521))                                                                                                                                                                             \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   ### Server changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   - Add `LLAMA_SERVER_SLOTS_N_DIFF` env var to widen the slot debug diff window ([#27600](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27600))                                                                                                                                              \\r\\n   - Slot fitting logic moved to the common `fit`, now accounting for `n_streams` ([#27496](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27496))                                                                                                                                             \\r\\n   - Adopt the common `json.h` abstraction ([#27511](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27511))                                                                                                                                                                                    \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   ### UI changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   - Tabbed navigation for chat conversations ([#27263](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27263))                                                                                                                                                                                 \\r\\n   - Fix keyboard shortcuts for the chat tabs navigation ([#27609](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27609))                                                                                                                                                                      \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   ### ggml changes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \\r\\n                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           \\r\\n   - ggml bumped to [v0.22.0](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v0.22.0) (ggml/1607):                                                                                                                                                                                          \\r\\n     - This release adds tensor-split support to the multi-backend (meta) backend with improved split-state propagation, reworks the Metal kernels into per-op sources with parallel compilation, and fixes `ggml_clamp` to be a proper non-in-place op. It also brings new ops            \\r\\n (`POOL_1D`, `PAD_REFLECT_1D`), Q2_K SYCL kernels, MoE bias fusion on OpenCL, and assorted fixes across the CUDA, Metal, SYCL, Vulkan, OpenCL and WebGPU backends. \\r\\n\\r\\n## Assets\\r\\n\\r\\n**Nightly build:** [b10621](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b10621)\\r\\n\\r\\n## More info\\r\\n\\r\\n- [Releases and versioning of
